verdict.rationale: A tax agency with a 'For Tax Software Developers' section could plausibly publish an API reference, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows only web-portal filing and IRS-schema XML file uploads, and every OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404. There is no evidence of an interactive API reference or runnable examples.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
